text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян conquers the Sprinters
Stakes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She smiles, looking extremely satisfied
as the
packed racecourse lovingly
chants, "Cute Curren
Chan!"
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Каррен Тян's followers increase tenfold.
She
becomes the number one trending
topic
worldwide and gets an
unbelievable number of
likes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is how Каррен Тян becomes the
most
beloved runner in the world, both
in name and in
reality. Next, she
wonders who it is that loves her
most of
all...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
"Juuust kidding! I know it's you!" She
shoots me an
irresistibly cute smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
